high_level_description: This image is a meme featuring two characters from the animated series "SpongeBob SquarePants." The top part of the image contains text that reads, "I never said that," followed by "Me:" indicating a humorous situation where someone is trying to deny something. The bottom part of the image shows SpongeBob SquarePants holding a large piece of paper with text on it, while Squidward, the snail character, looks at him with a surprised expression. Both characters are standing in front of a blue background that resembles a wall or a fence made of wooden planks.
